narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.content: {data_dave} joined the sync to discuss the raw data stream. He pointed out that the team is still copying files from the vendor portal into the staging bucket manually every morning. He mentioned that the script meant to automate this step has not been deployed to the production environment yet. He noted that the file naming conventions vary slightly between the Tuesday and Friday batches, which requires a quick visual check before the pipeline can process them. He described the current setup as a simple, unstructured transfer where the data lands exactly as the vendor sends it, without any automated validation or transformation layer in between.
output.reclassify_reason: The text is a descriptive summary of the current manual data ingestion process and its limitations, containing no explicit wishes, refusals, stated trade-offs, or requirements.
